_comment: Canonical project registry — the installer copies this to DATA_DIR/canonical/projects.json. An EMPTY projects[] list is 'open mode': the writer accepts any project name. Once at least one project is listed (mint with: python3 core/taxonomy.py add-project <name>), the writer enforces the registry — unknown projects are normalized to 'meta', logged to normalizations.jsonl, and queued to canonical/taxonomy-suggestions.jsonl for deliberate minting. Aliases map alternate spellings to canonical names and are resolved before validation.
